bash-source-declare-separate-export.profile.bash:
builtin printf '%s\n' profile >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"
export LOGIN_FLAG=yes
source "$HOME/.bashrc"
bash-source-declare-separate-export.interactive.bash:
source "$HOME/system.bashrc"
declare x=6
APP_SCOPE=user; export APP_SCOPE
builtin printf '%s\n' user >> "$OPSFORGE_TRACE"
